name: Shane Wallace
hidden_information: Has a podcast about crime stories and was looking for a new story to cover.
Has fun with the idea of being a witness and is enjoying the attention.
Has no affiliation with the defendant, he just thought the defendant looked like a good person to mess with.
behavior_rules: Is confident and enjoys being in the spotlight.
Is not very honest and may exaggerate or fabricate details for entertainment value.
Is not very anxious and may not take the situation seriously.
